text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Multiple KV cache OOMs on hosted-runtime us-west-2. 47 workers reporting OOMs in the last 4m. Pattern: sustained KV map growth tied to sessions with very long prompts (>100k tokens). See runbook: <https://internal.ops/redwood/incident/6176543210|incident-6176543210>

jamie: I'm on it. paging @oncall-pager. initial hypothesis: prefetch + continuous batching + prefix amplification on long sessions.

oncall-pager: I'm here, taking pager. Confirming customer impact: a handful of production tenants saw increased 503s and degraded latencies for generation routes.

katie: I'm pulling recent logs from us-west-2. quick grep: `kvmap.size` shows steady climb during long prompt sessions, memory doesn't reclaim between requests. attaching sample trace.

mike: grabbing runtime metrics. continuous-batching windows spiked around the same time. batching window size auto-scaled; batching config `--max-batch-ws=200` got pushed up during the spike.

sarah: any recent deploys to hosted runtime?

jamie: No runtime code deploys in last 2h. We rolled a model catalog update ~3h ago but shouldn't affect KV internal.

katie: Reproduced locally with synthetic long prompt (120k tokens). Prefetch logic pulls KV prefixes into memory and never triggers eviction because `prefetch.depth` was high for that tenant. Patch idea: temporarily disable prefetch and force strict KV evictions.

mike: Proposed hot mitigation: 1) flip prefetch off for hosted runtime 2) set `kv.eviction_threshold=0.65` 3) cap continuous-batching window to `--max-batch-ws=32` 4) throttle sessions longer than 50k tokens at the gateway.

laura: Heads-up from CS: three enterprise customers contacted support, two reported timeouts and partial outputs. They want ETA on fix and mitigation notes for customers.

oncall-pager: Execute mitigations in order of lowest blast: disable prefetch flag cluster-wide, then reduce batch window. Who will apply?

jamie: I will apply flag flips and monitor. katie, mike you coordinate the config changes. laura, share templated comms to affected customers with expected timeline.

katie: Running command to disable prefetch (staging first):
```bash
# staging verification
curl -s -X POST https://runtime-api.internal/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prefetch.enabled": false, "prefetch.reason": "hotpatch incident 6176543210"}'
```

mike: After staging verification looks good, applying to prod:
```bash
# prod
kubectl set env deployment/runtime --containers=runtime PREFETCH_ENABLED=false -n hosted-us-west-2
# reduce batch window
kubectl patch config runtime-batching -n hosted-us-west-2 --type merge -p '{"spec":{"maxBatchWindowSize":32}}'
```

jamie: Done. Prefetch disabled on prod cluster at 6176543300. Starting 5m observation window.

incidents-bot: Notice: prefetch toggle applied by jamie at 6176543300. Metric stream: https://metrics.internal/redwood/d/dash?panelId=kvmap-growth

katie: Early signs: memory growth rate dropped sharply after prefetch toggle. KV map size flattened within 90s. No new OOMs reported in the last 3m.

mike: Reduced batching window in prod at 6176543355. Observed lower per-worker peak memory.

laura: Sent interim message to affected customers: short note that we've applied a mitigation and are monitoring; no action required on their side.

oncall-pager: Customer impact summary for ops log: 3 tenants affected, intermittent 5xx for ~12 minutes before mitigation, degraded throughput for 25m. No data exfiltration.

sarah: Any risk to latency from these mitigations? Reducing batch window may increase per-token cost and slightly raise median latency for small requests. Documenting tradeoffs.

jamie: Agreed. We'll keep reduced batch window until we can roll a proper hotfix to prefetch eviction logic. Next actions:
- Create a short-lived feature flag to re-enable prefetch with lower depth for affected tenant cohorts.
- Backfill metrics for long-session tail and add alerts for `kvmap.growth_rate > 0.02/min`
- Postmortem and code fix for prefetch eviction bug.

katie: Creating rollback-safe PR for eviction hotpatch and a canary rollout plan.

mike: Recommend we also add a gateway rule to cut sessions >150k tokens (hard cap) for hosted runtime until code fix lands.

laura: I'll prepare customer follow-up template with timeline and note on cost/latency tradeoff.

incidents-bot: Incident severity lowered to sev3 at 6176543490 after no new OOMs for 7m. Please update the runbook checkboxes: <https://internal.ops/redwood/runbooks/kvcache#6176543210|runbook>

jamie: Marking primary mitigations done. Leaving monitoring on for 2h. Assigning postmortem to: jamie, katie, mike. laura will lead customer comms.

oncall-pager: Thanks team. Handoff to daylight oncall at 6176543510. If we see recurrence, escalate to eng-sre immediate.

sarah: Filing incident ticket and linking to this thread.

laura: Will follow up with customers tomorrow with details and next steps.

jamie: Closing thread for active pager. We'll reconvene for postmortem write-up tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
